51408041.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM5 sensor chip immobilized recombinant human AChE assessed as dissociation constant at 298.15 K by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) at 298.15 K. Recombinant human AChE (rhAChE) was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip (GE Healthcare) via amine coupling. The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, containing 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% P20, and 0.02% NaN3. The ligand concentration was 1000 RU. The analytes were prepared in the running buffer at concentrations ranging from 0.01 to 100 nM. The association phase lasted for 120 s, followed by a 300 s dissociation phase. The regeneration step was performed with 10 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.0, for 30 s. The data were analyzed using Biacore T200 Evaluation Software 3.0. The kinetic parameters (kon, koff, and KD) were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
